{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|In a move that stunned political observers, the Dentaal Independence Party, with full public support, ousted the Imperial administration of Governor Taliff and took direct control of the Dentaalian government it had vacated only nine months earlier.|[[Imperial HoloVision]]|<ref name="AJ5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Dentaal Independence Party''' or '''DIP''' was formed after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] conquered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]]. After [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Taliff]] disbanded the [[Dentaalian House]], the former members met and, under leadership of [[Hancc Rellow]], created the DIP. The DIP then [[Dentaal Uprising|overthrew]] Taliff; however, the Empire responded by having [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] seed the world with the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]].
